title: Retail Betting Markets
title_zh: 零售博彩市场
authors: Scott R. Baker, Justin Balthrop, Mark J. Johnson, Jason D. Kotter, Kevin Pisciotta
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the rapid expansion and convergence of retail betting markets. We analyze market design elements, discuss economic utility, and highlight shared behavioral drivers of sports betting markets, prediction markets, and retail options trading. Our review underscores how technological innovation, behavioral biases, and regulatory arbitrage have shaped recent market evolution. We highlight important considerations for policy-makers facing a changing landscape and outline possibilities for further research.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了零售博彩市场的快速扩张与趋同现象。我们分析了市场设计要素，探讨了经济效用，并揭示了体育博彩市场、预测市场与零售期权交易共有的行为驱动因素。本综述强调技术创新、行为偏差与监管套利如何塑造了近期市场演变。我们为面临不断变化格局的政策制定者提出重要考量，并勾勒出未来研究的可能性方向。

title: Beliefs That Predict Returns and Beliefs That Attract Flows: Policy Insights and Sentiment Catering in Mutual Funds
title_zh: 预测回报的信念与吸引资金的信念：共同基金中的政策洞察与情绪迎合
authors: Zhenyu Gao, Wei Xiong, Jian Yuan
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Using mandatory Outlook reports from Chinese mutual funds, we decompose each fund’s equity-market beliefs into macro fundamentals, government policy, and residual sentiment. Policy beliefs, rather than macro beliefs, predict subsequent market returns and help explain the positive alphas observed in China’s mutual fund industry. By contrast, residual sentiment strongly shapes equity allocations and attracts investor flows, even though it does not predict returns. Using maturing wealth management products as an instrument for future aggregate fund flows, we show that funds strategically position their stated beliefs to cater to investors. Overall, our analysis reveals a core tension in active asset management: skilled managers generate performance through policy insights while attracting flows through sentiment alignment.
abstract_zh: 利用中国共同基金的强制性Outlook报告，我们将每只基金的股票市场信念分解为宏观基本面、政府政策和残余情绪。政策信念（而非宏观信念）能够预测后续市场回报，并有助于解释中国共同基金行业观察到的正Alpha。相比之下，残余情绪虽无法预测回报，却显著影响股票配置并吸引投资者资金流入。以即将到期的理财产品作为未来基金总资金流的工具变量，我们发现基金会策略性地调整其陈述的信念以迎合投资者。总体而言，我们的分析揭示了主动资产管理中的核心矛盾：具备技能的基金经理通过政策洞察创造业绩，却需通过情绪迎合来吸引资金流入。

title: DP41 Public Sector Shadow Prices in Distorted General Equilibrium Models
title_zh: DP41 扭曲一般均衡模型中的公共部门影子价格
authors: Alasdair Smith
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In a closed competitive general equilibrium constant returns economy, consumer taxes separate consumer and producer prices of goods. Shadow prices appropriate for the evaluation of public sector projects are derived on alternative assumptions about what happens to taxes as public production changes. In some examples, equilibrium prices and shadow prices are computed, and these computations suggest both that shadow prices are quite sensitive to the precise specification of pre-existing distortions and also that partial equilibrium intuition about the relation between shadow prices and market prices may be seriously misleading. The possibility of extending the analysis to more realistic examples and models is discussed.
abstract_zh: 在封闭竞争性一般均衡的规模报酬不变经济中，消费税将商品的消费者价格与生产者价格分离。基于公共生产变化时税收调整的不同假设，推导出适用于公共部门项目评估的影子价格。通过若干算例计算均衡价格与影子价格，结果表明：影子价格对既有扭曲的具体设定高度敏感，且关于影子价格与市场价格关系的局部均衡直觉可能产生严重误导。本文进一步探讨了将该分析拓展至更现实案例与模型的可能性。

title: Regularization and the Formation of Social Capital: Evidence from Forced Migrants in Colombia
title_zh: 正规化与社会资本的形成：来自哥伦比亚强制移民的证据
authors: Rozo, Sandra V.
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper estimates the medium-run effects, 4.5 years after launch, of a regularization program that granted temporary legal status, freedom of movement, work authorization, and access to social programs to nearly half a million Venezuelan forced migrants in Colombia with no criminal record. Because the program was announced unexpectedly and applied retroactively to migrants who had registered in a census before a sharp eligibility cutoff, the paper identifies its effects using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design and a unique two-wave panel survey. The largest medium-run gains were in social capital. At the cutoff, eligible migrants scored 0.95 standard deviation higher than ineligible peers on a social integration index capturing belonging, friendships with Colombians, community participation, and attachment to Colombia, and 0.97 standard deviation higher on a prosocial behavior index measuring generalized trust and trust toward both Colombians and Venezuelans. Neither effect is detectable in the short run, and both emerge only over time. Economic gains, by contrast, arose immediately and largely persisted. Eligible migrants earned 69 percent higher monthly labor income, scored 2.6 standard deviations higher on a service access index, and made substantial investments in housing, with housing quality increasing from 0.60 to 1.27 standard deviations between survey waves. The implied fiscal savings to Colombia also increased over time, rising from roughly 40 to 70 percent of the fiscal cost associated with irregular households as beneficiaries moved toward fiscal balance. These findings suggest that the largest social capital and fiscal returns to regularization accrued gradually through sustained legal inclusion and repeated positive interactions with institutions and host communities rather than through the act of legalization itself.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了一项合法化计划在启动四年半后的中期效应。该计划向近50万在哥伦比亚无犯罪记录的委内瑞拉被迫移民授予临时合法身份、自由迁徙权、工作许可及社会项目准入资格。由于该计划系突然宣布，且对在严格资格截止日期前完成人口普查登记的移民具有追溯效力，本文利用模糊断点回归设计及独特的两轮面板调查数据识别其影响。中期最大收益体现在社会资本领域：在断点处，符合资格的移民在社会融合指数（涵盖归属感、与哥伦比亚人的友谊、社区参与及对哥伦比亚的依恋）上得分比不符合资格的同伴高0.95个标准差，在亲社会行为指数（衡量普遍信任及对哥伦比亚人与委内瑞拉人的信任）上得分高0.97个标准差。这两种效应在短期内均不可观测，且随时间推移才逐渐显现。相比之下，经济收益则立即产生并基本持续：符合资格的移民月劳动收入高出69%，服务获取指数得分高出2.6个标准差，并在住房方面进行大量投资，住房质量在两轮调查间从0.60个标准差提升至1.27个标准差。哥伦比亚的隐含财政节约也随时间增长，随着受益者逐步实现财政平衡，从约占非正规家庭相关财政成本的40%上升至70%。这些发现表明，合法化带来的最大社会资本与财政回报是通过持续的法律包容及与制度、东道社区的反复积极互动逐步累积的，而非源于合法化行为本身。

title: DP518 Destabilizing Effects of Exchange-Rate Escape Clauses
title_zh: DP518 汇率逃避条款的不稳定效应
authors: Maurice Obstfeld
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies the merits of policy rules with escape clauses, analysing as an example fixed exchange rate systems that allow member countries the freedom to realign in periods of stress. Motivating this example is the debate within the European Monetary System over how quickly to move from the current regime of national currencies, linked by pegged but adjustable exchange rates, to a single European currency. The paper's main point is that while well-designed rules with escape clauses can raise society's welfare in principle, limited credibility makes it difficult for governments to implement such rules in practice. An EMS-type institution which presumably imposes a political cost on policy-makers who realign may lead to an optimal escape-clause equilibrium, but may just as well lead to alternative equilibria far inferior to an irrevocably fixed exchange rate. Countries can suffer periods in which no realignment occurs, yet unemployment, real wages, and ex post real interest rates remain persistently and sub-optimally high.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了带有例外条款的政策规则的优劣，并以允许成员国在压力时期自由调整汇率的固定汇率制度为例进行分析。这一例子的动机源于欧洲货币体系内部关于应从当前由可调整钉住汇率联结的国家货币体系，以多快速度过渡到单一欧洲货币的争论。本文的核心观点是：尽管设计良好的例外条款规则在理论上能够提升社会福利，但有限的可信度使得政府在实践中难以实施此类规则。一个类似欧洲货币体系的制度安排，若对进行汇率调整的政策制定者施加政治成本，可能会产生最优的例外条款均衡，但也同样可能导致远不如不可撤销的固定汇率制度的替代均衡。各国可能经历无汇率调整的时期，但失业率、实际工资以及事后实际利率却持续处于次优的高位。

title: Labor Market Discrimination and the Racial Unemployment Gap: Can Monetary Policy Make a Difference?
title_zh: 劳动力市场歧视与种族失业差距：货币政策能否有所作为？
authors: Cairó, Isabel, Lipton, Avi
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Black workers experience higher, more volatile unemployment than white workers, a racial dis- parity unexplained by observables. A New Keynesian model with a frictional labor market, endogenous separations, and employer discrimination explains these outcomes. We use the model to assess how alternative monetary policy strategies affect labor market outcomes by race. Switching to a monetary policy rule where interest rates respond to shortfalls of employment from its maximum level instead of deviations raises inflation and does not reduce the racial unemployment gap. A monetary policy rule where interest rates respond to the racial unemployment gap also fails to reduce the gap.
abstract_zh: 黑人劳动者相较于白人劳动者面临更高且更不稳定的失业率，这一种族差异无法由可观测因素解释。一个包含摩擦性劳动力市场、内生性离职及雇主歧视的新凯恩斯模型解释了这些现象。我们利用该模型评估了不同货币政策策略如何按种族影响劳动力市场结果。若将货币政策规则调整为利率对就业水平与最大就业水平之间的缺口（而非偏离程度）作出反应，会导致通胀上升且无法缩小种族失业差距。而利率对种族失业缺口作出反应的货币政策规则同样未能缩小这一差距。

title: Trapped at home: Climate stress is more likely to immobilise the poor than to move them
title_zh: 困于家中：气候压力更可能使穷人无法迁移而非促其流动
authors: Céline Azémar, Rodolphe Desbordes, Markus Eberhardt, Eric Neumayer
official: 官方在线 2026-07-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Climate-driven displacement is widely expected to push millions across international borders. Drawing on monthly bilateral flows for 127 developing-country origins, this column finds the reverse: a temperature shock reduces emigration rather than raising it, because climate stress cuts origin incomes and poor households cannot finance a costly international move. On this evidence, the ‘climate refugee’ is the exception, and hardship more often traps poor populations in place than sets them moving.
abstract_zh: 气候驱动的流离失所现象被广泛预期将推动数百万人跨越国际边界。本文基于127个发展中国家来源地的月度双边人口流动数据，发现了相反的结果：温度冲击反而减少了移民数量，而非增加移民数量，原因是气候压力降低了来源地收入，贫困家庭无力承担高昂的国际迁移成本。基于这一证据，"气候难民"属于例外情况，而困境更常使贫困人口困在原地，而非促使他们迁移。

title: A Tale of Two Market Returns: The Broad Market Factor and The Idiosyncratic Financial Factor
title_zh: 两种市场收益的故事：广泛市场因子与特质金融因子
authors: Sung Je Byun, Johnathan Loudis, Lawrence D.W. Schmidt
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We construct a Broad Market Factor (BMF), which is a proxy for the value-weighted equity return on all firms in the US economy (public and private). The BMF differs from the standard Value-weighted Market Factor (VMF), which reflects the value-weighted equity return on public firms. We define the difference between the VMF and the BMF to be the Idiosyncratic Financial Factor (IFF). The IFF carries no risk premium and is uncorrelated with all macroeconomic proxies for investor marginal utility we consider. CAPM betas and, consequently, discount rates are underestimated when measured with respect to the VMF compared to the BMF for most portfolios. Size factors become redundant and the size anomaly is resolved when the VMF is replaced by the BMF in standard factor models. The intertemporal risk-return relation is substantially stronger when one replaces the VMF with the BMF. The unifying explanation for these results is that the IFF adds unpriced risk to the VMF, distorting both cross-sectional and time-series estimates of exposure to priced market risk.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个广义市场因子（BMF），用以代表美国经济中所有企业（包括上市公司与非上市公司）的价值加权股权回报。BMF与标准价值加权市场因子（VMF）存在差异，后者仅反映上市公司的价值加权股权回报。我们将VMF与BMF之间的差值定义为特质金融因子（IFF）。该IFF不包含风险溢价，且与我们考虑的所有投资者边际效用宏观经济代理变量均不相关。对于大多数投资组合而言，相较于基于BMF的测算，基于VMF的CAPM贝塔值及由此得出的贴现率均被低估。当标准因子模型中的VMF被BMF替代时，规模因子变得冗余，规模异象得以消除。用BMF替代VMF后，跨期风险-收益关系显著增强。这些结果的统一解释是：IFF为VMF增加了未定价风险，从而扭曲了横截面与时间序列上对定价市场风险暴露程度的估计。

title: Taxing the Wealth of the Poor:Evidence from the Danish Old-Age Support Asset Test
title_zh: 对穷人财富征税：来自丹麦老年支持资产审查的证据

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We document strong behavioral responses to an asset test for an old-age support program in Denmark using comprehensive administrative data. We show that the density distribution of the liquid assets targeted by the test exhibits large but diffuse excess mass below the threshold for the treated group relative to control groups of comparable but ineligible individuals. A cohort analysis exploiting the panel structure suggests that the program reduces liquid assets by 20 percent around the threshold. Analyzing high-frequency bank data on assets and cash withdrawals shows that the excess mass around the threshold largely reflects permanent rather than temporary responses. (JEL D91, G51, H24, H55, I32, J14)
abstract_zh: 我们利用全面的行政数据，记录了丹麦一项老年支持计划中资产测试引发的强烈行为反应。研究表明，该测试所针对的流动资产密度分布在阈值以下呈现出大量但分散的超额聚集，相较于具有可比性但不符合条件的对照组而言。基于面板结构的队列分析表明，该计划使阈值附近的流动资产减少了20%。通过对资产和现金提取的高频银行数据进行分析，发现阈值附近的超额聚集主要反映的是永久性而非暂时性反应。（JEL分类号：D91, G51, H24, H55, I32, J14）

title: Globalization, Innovation, and Margins of Sourcing

authors: Wenzhuo Lu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper uncovers that input tariff reductions result in less domestic innovation, but standard models of trade ensure a positive correlation between importing and innovation. Hence, the paper develops a dynamic framework with a task-specific laboraugmenting productivity and a non-homothetic import demand system to rationalize this finding. The model implies that input liberalization enables firms to use cheaper intermediate imports as a substitute for self-made inputs, a strategy that decreases marginal production costs but also discourages firms from investing in their own inhouse varieties. Finally, the paper compares the effectiveness of trade and innovation policies in boosting aggregate productivity growth.
abstract_zh: 本文发现，投入品关税削减导致国内创新减少，而标准贸易模型却认为进口与创新之间存在正相关关系。为此，本文构建了一个包含任务特定劳动增强型生产率与非同质进口需求体系的动态框架，以解释这一发现。模型表明，投入品自由化使企业能够用更便宜的进口中间品替代自制投入品，这一策略虽降低了边际生产成本，但也抑制了企业对自主开发内部品种的投资。最后，本文比较了贸易政策与创新政策在促进全要素生产率增长方面的有效性。

title: Administrative Capacity in Public Procurement: Evidence and Mechanisms
title_zh: 公共采购中的行政能力：证据与机制
authors: Audinga Baltrunaite, Sauro Mocetti, Gabriele Rovigatti
official: 官方在线 2025-10-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper investigates the role of administrative capacity in shaping procurement outcomes using rich Italian data on public works. We analyse the duration of the three main phases – planning, awarding, and execution – for observationally equivalent projects. First, we document substantial heterogeneity across contracting authorities: their fixed effects account for a sizeable share of the variation in procurement length, and delays tend to persist across all phases, pointing to structural differences in organizational capacity. These differences are strongly correlated with indicators of administrative quality. Second, we show that the identity of the procurement manager (RUP) matters, even within the same organization. Observable characteristics such as education or tenure explain only a limited fraction of the variation, highlighting the importance of unobservable factors such as tacit knowledge, effort, and managerial skills. Third, in the execution phase, both procuring authorities and firms play a crucial role: execution times are shorter when projects are awarded to more productive firms, and higher-ability managers are more likely to select such firms.
abstract_zh: 本文利用意大利公共工程的丰富数据，探究行政能力对采购结果的影响。我们分析了观察等价项目的三个主要阶段——规划、招标与执行——的持续时间。首先，我们记录了签约机构之间存在显著的异质性：其固定效应解释了采购时长变异的相当大一部分，且延误往往在所有阶段持续存在，这表明组织能力存在结构性差异。这些差异与行政质量指标高度相关。其次，我们证明采购经理（RUP）的身份至关重要，即使在同一个组织内部也是如此。教育背景或任职年限等可观测特征仅能解释有限比例的变异，这凸显了隐性知识、努力程度和管理技能等不可观测因素的重要性。第三，在执行阶段，采购机构与企业均发挥关键作用：当项目被授予生产率更高的企业时，执行时间更短，而能力更强的经理更倾向于选择此类企业。

title: Gender Homophily, Collaboration, and Output
title_zh: 性别同质性、合作与产出
authors: Lorenzo Ductor, Anja Prummer
official: 官方在线 2023-04-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We consider the implications of gender homophily in Economics, which has persisted despite the significant increase in women in the field. As women remain underrepresented, gender homophily may serve as a constraint in collaboration. It could also lead to less gender diverse co-author teams than may be optimal in terms of generating high quality research papers. We show that gender homophily neither constrains collaboration nor prevents higher quality output. This implies that a mere increase in women in Economics will not be sufficient to erase existing gender inequalities.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了经济学中性别同质性的影响，尽管该领域女性人数显著增加，但性别同质性现象依然持续存在。由于女性仍处于代表性不足的状态，性别同质性可能成为合作中的制约因素。此外，它可能导致合著团队的性别多样性低于产出高质量研究论文的最优水平。我们证明，性别同质性既不会限制合作，也不会阻碍更高质量成果的产生。这意味着，仅靠增加经济学领域的女性人数并不足以消除现有的性别不平等现象。
